__comment: COMMITTED-SAFE PLACEHOLDER — NOT a real Firebase config. This file exists ONLY so the `dev` product flavor (applicationId app.jeeb.mobile.dev) can compile: the com.google.gms.google-services Gradle plugin requires a client whose package_name matches the variant applicationId, and the real android/app/google-services.json (gitignored) only carries the production package app.jeeb.mobile. Every value below is an intentionally fake placeholder and carries NO live credential. Because the google-services plugin resolves per-flavor source sets (src/<flavor>/ takes priority over app/), the `dev` flavor uses this placeholder while `production`/`staging` still use the real, gitignored android/app/google-services.json. RUNTIME NOTE: with this fake api_key, Firebase.initializeApp() parses fine and the app boots, but FCM token retrieval and Crashlytics upload will log a benign 'invalid API key' warning. To get real FCM/Crashlytics on dev, drop a real google-services.json (with an app.jeeb.mobile.dev client) here or at android/app/google-services.json — it stays gitignored. NEVER replace these placeholder values in this committed file with a real key.
